eq-ch02-laws-increment: The flux-only stage increment is minus $\Delta t/V_i$ times the difference of area-weighted face fluxes.
eq-ch02-ideal-gas-pressure: Ideal gas: internal energy from total energy minus kinetic energy, then pressure, temperature and sound speed.
eq-ch02-ideal-moist-factors: The moist factors $f_\varepsilon$ (gas constant) and $f_\sigma$ (heat capacity) of a mixture relative to dry air.
eq-ch02-ideal-moist-energy: Ideal-moist internal energy and pressure, with the species reference energies removed before the pressure.
eq-ch02-ideal-moist-gamma: The ideal-moist adiabatic index at frozen composition: $\gamma = 1 + (\gamma_d - 1) f_\varepsilon / f_\sigma$.
eq-ch02-moist-mixture-speed: Moist-mixture isothermal sound speed from the compressibility factors, the mixture $\gamma$, and $c_s = \sqrt{\gamma}\,c_T$.
eq-ch02-moist-mixture-newton: Newton update of temperature from internal energy, with the volumetric heat capacity as derivative.
eq-ch02-moist-mixture-integral: Species internal energy for nine-coefficient polynomial heat capacities, referenced to 300 K so the energy zero is unchanged.
eq-ch02-moist-mixture-rotor: Heat capacity of H2 from the variance of the rotational level energy (levels 0 to 40).
eq-ch02-aneos-gamma: The effective adiabatic index of a tabulated EOS from its sound speed, pressure and density.
eq-ch02-shallow-water-speed: Shallow water: the squared wave speed is the stored depth variable (gravity absorbed).
eq-ch02-consistency-affine: With constant heat capacities, internal energy density is affine in temperature at fixed partial densities.
eq-ch02-consistency-enthalpy: The species enthalpies plus kinetic energy, dry row included, sum to $E + p$.
eq-ch02-saturation-energy: Phase equilibrium at fixed volume and energy: reaction extents change concentrations, with non-negative results and fixed internal energy density.
